IMC Investor Presentation on San and Dunajec Licences in Poland

Prospex Energy plc (AIM: PXEN), the AIM-quoted investing company focused on European gas and power projects, is pleased to announce that Tom Reynolds, Chief Executive Officer, will provide a live presentation to update investors on its Polish licences, San and Dunajec, with a focus on the Mniszow oil discovery in the Dunajec block, via Investor Meet Company on 21 September 2026 at 12:00 BST.

The presentation is open to all existing and potential shareholders, and marks the first in a series of detailed presentations that will focus on Prospex’s asset portfolio to provide investors with a more granular understanding of each opportunity. Questions can be submitted pre-event via your Investor Meet Company dashboard up until 20 Sept 2026 at 09:00 BST, or at any time during the live presentation.

Investors who already follow PROSPEX ENERGY PLC on the Investor Meet Company platform will automatically be invited.
For further information visit www.prospex.energy or contact the following:

Prospex Energy plc (AIM:PXEN) is an energy investing company focused on identifying, investing in and developing oil, gas and power opportunities in Europe. The Company’s portfolio includes producing assets, near-term development projects and exploration opportunities across Spain, Italy and Poland.

The investment portfolio includes interests in the Selva Malvezzi gas field in Italy, the El Romeral gas-to-power project in Spain, the Viura gas field in northern Spain, and the San and Dunajec licences in Poland, including the Mniszów oil discovery.
Prospex’s strategy is to invest capital and expertise to develop its assets, maximise their value and, where appropriate, realise investments and re-invest capital into new opportunities.
